summary: Fixed (slightly drifting) camera facing a wooden desk with a row of objects. A hand at the right edge rolls/flicks a white egg leftwards along the desk top in front of the objects; the egg rolls right-to-left, slowing, and leaves the frame at the left edge.

camera.type: static on a support or handheld-steady; slow smooth drift only
camera.shift_vs_frame0_px: scene/camera_shift.json  [frame, dx, dy]  (phase correlation on wall/monitor region y<650, x<1500; content moves by (dx,dy) relative to frame 0)
camera.note: drift is ~0.1-0.3 px/frame, <0.7% of the egg's per-frame motion; egg.csv gives both raw image coords (ref_x, ref_y) and drift-compensated coords in frame-0 alignment (ref_x_aligned, ref_y_aligned)

perspective: near-frontal view of the desk; egg rolls along a line roughly parallel to the image x axis (y 786 -> 792 px, i.e. drifting very slightly towards the camera); apparent egg height grows 77 -> 80 px from right to left (~4%). Desk front edge near y ~1000 px; desk/wall junction hidden behind objects around y ~600-650.

egg.description: white (bluish-white in shadow-free light) chicken egg, the only moving prop; rolls on its side right->left along the desk at y~786-792 px
egg.visible_frames: 18 (sliver in hand at right edge) ... 58 (partly outside left edge); fully free and in frame 20-56
egg.reference_point: ref_x, ref_y = midpoint of the egg's visible left/right and top/bottom edges

pixel_size.width_px_blurred_f20_24: 91-101 (motion blur adds ~20 px at the fastest frames)
pixel_size.note: egg appears nearly circular (seen roughly end-on / tumbling). Its length along the motion direction is best taken as ~79 px (= height and visual full width); the half-max edge width (~74) misses the darker right (shaded) side.

hand.description: a person's hand (right side of frame, x > ~1820 px, y ~ 700-860) that launches the egg
hand.visible_frames: 0-60 (always partly visible at the right edge, mostly outside the frame)
hand.events: rests 0-~11; swings in/out 12-19 (motion blurred); egg leaves fingers at frame 19-20; hand rests on desk again at right edge from ~21

white_bowl.description: white wavy-rimmed ceramic bowl, far left

iced_tea_bottle.description: plastic iced-tea bottle with yellow cap and orange liquid/label, left of centre

white_cylinder_cup.description: white/cream cylindrical cup or vase with diagonal ridges, right of centre

red_kettle.description: red Tefal electric kettle, right of centre (spout left, handle right)

monitor.description: black computer monitor behind the objects
monitor.note: top cut by frame; screen width ~887 px

desk_lamp.description: black articulated desk lamp, right; shade top right

flowers.description: dark red roses at the far right edge

desk.description: light wooden desk top, the rolling surface
desk.note: the egg rolls ~30-40 px in front of (below in image) the object bases (y 753-771)

events.event: egg first visible (in hand, right edge)
egg release (last contact with fingers at 19, free at 20)
egg rolls right->left; no bounce, no collision with any object
near-constant rolling (per-frame dx 43-45 px), slight further slowdown to ~41-42 px at 53-56
egg centre (ref_x) within the red kettle's x-range
egg centre within the white cup's x-range
egg centre within the green bottle's x-range
egg centre within the iced-tea bottle's x-range
egg centre within the white bowl's x-range
